meta.title: Taskboard · Host
meta.description:
The half of the taskboard that runs inside the DSH process. Three separate jobs:

(1) HTTP routes for the browser UI — reading and writing cards, workspaces, templates, permission levels, incremental updates and the SSE event stream. These are the UI’s own data channel, not a public API for outside integrations.
(2) Eleven tools for agents — get, list, create, update, re-note, transition, read definitions, read the raw card, read and write permission policies, list workspaces. They adapt the host-agnostic definitions in @taskboard/tools to the DSH tool pipeline.
(3) Three slash commands: taskboard, task-card and task-create.

It also installs a tool-call guard that denies or admits agent tool calls according to the taskboard permission levels; the decision logic itself lives in core.

It renders no UI, persists nothing and defines no domain rules — those belong to dsh-client, store and core. It does not decide who may see which card; the DSH session and workspace boundaries do.

Switch it off and the data and the UI remain, but the UI cannot load data, agents cannot use the taskboard tools, and the slash commands disappear.
